improvementsText: Small repairs and carefully chosen improvements can make a property work better, look more cared for and remain useful for longer. We assess the issue, discuss options and recommend a practical way forward for the work in scope. Where an issue involves restricted building work, consent or specialist trades, the necessary appropriately licensed or qualified providers are engaged as required.
residentialText: Homeowners, landlords, investors and property managers often need a reliable way to deal with a growing list of small jobs. We can help with general repairs, interior maintenance, worn doors and hardware, damaged timber, decks, fences, exterior upkeep and pre-sale or pre-tenancy improvements. We consider the condition of the property and how it is used, then agree a practical scope that addresses the priorities.

badge.alt: Site Safe Member — Proud to be safe

commercialText: Commercial premises need to remain functional, presentable and properly maintained for the people who work in or visit them. We support building owners, business operators and property managers with repairs and planned maintenance, communicating about access and scheduling so work can be organised around day-to-day operations where practical. Specialist work can be coordinated with appropriate trades when required.
introText: Paint weathers. Gutters clog. Timber takes on moisture. Doors and fittings loosen with use. A small problem can become a larger repair when it is left unattended, so maintenance is most useful when it is considered before something fails. We can help assess what needs attention now, what can be planned and where specialist advice or trades are needed.
preventativeText: Auckland buildings face changing weather, moisture, movement, everyday wear and materials that age at different rates. Routine checks can help identify issues such as deteriorating paint, blocked gutters, damaged seals, loose fittings or early timber decay. Timely repairs do not prevent every future problem, but they can help reduce avoidable deterioration and give owners a clearer basis for planning upkeep.
description: Property maintenance is about more than putting things right after they fail. Weather, moisture, movement, use and ageing materials all affect a building over time. We help homeowners, landlords, investors, property managers and commercial owners identify repair needs, plan practical work and keep properties in good working condition.
assetText: For landlords, investors and commercial property owners, maintenance is part of understanding the condition of an asset and making informed decisions about it. We can assist with condition observations, maintenance scheduling, identifying visible deterioration and prioritising repairs according to property needs and agreed budgets. This supports a considered approach to long-term upkeep rather than relying only on reactive repairs.

services.title: Residential Property Maintenance
services.description: ANDRO provides practical residential property maintenance across Auckland for homeowners, landlords and property managers. From general repairs, plastering and minor wall repairs to interior and exterior painting, we help keep homes in good condition. Our work can include doors, locks, handles and hardware, deck and fence repairs, gutter cleaning and exterior upkeep, rental and preventative maintenance, and pre-sale or pre-tenancy improvements. We assess the property and agree a clear, practical scope before work begins.

services.title: Commercial Property Maintenance
services.description: We support Auckland offices, retail premises and other commercial properties with general building repairs and planned or reactive maintenance. Work may include interior and exterior upkeep, painting and surface repairs, doors, fixtures and fittings, and minor refurbishment or improvement works. We prioritise reliable delivery and professional communication, plan work with your team to help minimise disruption to business operations, and can coordinate specialist subcontractors when required.
